about: railfps FPS self-check (P68-F T6, re-measured in T9): Playwright project pixel7-touch (412x839 portrait, touch), CPU x4 via CDP like the phone profile of e2e/play-perf.spec.ts that produced evals/play/p66/baseline-fps.json; this machine GPU, not a phone. Robot plays via "Show me how" (real-time demo of the verified run), restarted after a win inside the window; frames are requestAnimationFrame intervals in the page counted only while the demo runs, 20 s in total. medianFps = 1000 / median frame time.
